title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Poliwhirl 151 061/165 Reverse Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Poliwhirl card is a must-have for any serious Pokémon TCG collector. With a beautiful reverse holo finish and a card number of 061/165, this card is sure to impress. The card features the character Poliwhirl, known for its unique abilities in the game.

Manufactured by The Pokémon Company in Japan and illustrated by Shinji Kanda, this card is made from high-quality card stock and is part of the [SV2a] 151 set. It is standard sized and suitable for players aged 6 and above. This card is not autographed and is not considered vintage. Get your hands on this rare Poliwhirl card today and add it to your collection!
